The '''Lasat''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] indigenous to the arid [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lasan/Legends|Lasan]].

==Biology and appearance==
Coming from an arid world with extensive [[Desert/Legends|deserts]], the Lasat developed many features to protect them from the climate. They had pointed [[Ear/Legends|ears]] that assisted with heat dissipation and thin [[Hair/Legends|fur]] to insulate their bodies at night. The fur was brown in color, and males usually had longer fur. The fur could cover the entire body except for the face, hands and tail. They had small nasal and oral openings, but large [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] to improve their nightvision.<ref name="AJ11">{{JournalCite|11|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref>

==Society and culture==
Lasat society was held together by a long-standing oral tradition, featuring clever and stealthy heroes. Their social structure was largely nomadic, though powerful city-states existed, with buildings constructed of mud and brick. Both the cities and the tribes were ruled by hereditary religious figures, with laws being enforced by a warrior-police caste.

Political and economic concerns lead frequently to wars in which the tribal nomads often served as [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]].
The Lasat were considered "crafty" or "sneaky" by [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at large due to their tendency to capture their food by trapping. Individuals did not use pronouns when referring to themselves, preferring to use proper names. They did use pronouns when referring to other beings as they preferred to not user other's names.<ref name="AJ11" />

==Lasat in the galaxy==
Only a relatively small number of Lasat left their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], apparently as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. Fortunately for them, the Lasat made poor slaves and many were skilled at crafting explosives out of common chemical agents. Their servitude was short lived.

Occasionally, ignorant citizens of the galaxy mistook exceptionally tall or bulky Lasat for [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], due to their (typically) light-brown fur, which sometimes resembled Wookiee fur on males of the species (Lasat females had much shorter hair).

A notable Lasat was [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Puggles Trodd/Legends|Puggles Trodd]].<ref name="AJ11" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ChewieConceptArt.jpg|thumb|125px|[[Ralph McQuarrie]]'s concept artwork]]
The appearance of the Lasat species is based on early concept drawings by [[Ralph McQuarrie]] for the character that became [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="Back from the Drawing Board: Recycled Star Wars Aliens">{{SW|url=news/back-from-the-drawing-board-recycled-star-wars-aliens|text=Back from the Drawing Board: Recycled ''Star Wars'' Aliens|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref>
